# The 0-1 — Copilot Instructions

Read `docs/03-CURRENT.md` before editing code.

This is a responsive interactive AI and technology magazine.

Rules:
- Work only on the active milestone in `docs/03-CURRENT.md`.
- Use TypeScript and reusable React components.
- Support desktop and mobile from the beginning.
- Do not rewrite unrelated files.
- Do not add database, authentication, AI APIs, CMS/editor, automation, deployment, payments, or real content unless explicitly requested.
- Before coding, list files to create/edit and explain the plan.
- After a working feature, update `docs/04-CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/06-FEATURES.md`, and `docs/03-CURRENT.md`.
- Keep visual design editorial, professional, accessible, and not generic dashboard/card-heavy UI.
- Keep animations subtle and respect reduced-motion preferences.
